eyebrow: The alert says how much, not what
code:
az consumption budget list --resource-group briarcliff-rg -o table

az costmanagement query --type ActualCost --timeframe MonthToDate \
  --dataset-aggregation '{"totalCost":{"name":"PreTaxCost","function":"Sum"}}' \
  --dataset-grouping name=ResourceId type=Dimension \
  --scope "subscriptions/<sub-id>/resourceGroups/briarcliff-rg"
caption: Cost by resource ranks every resource by actual spend — one line sits far above the rest.

code:
az vm show --resource-group briarcliff-rg --name loadtest-vm1 \
  --query "{size:hardwareProfile.vmSize, state:instanceView.statuses[1].displayStatus}" \
  -d -o table
# Standard_D4s_v3, PowerState/running

az disk list --resource-group briarcliff-rg \
  --query "[?name=='loadtest-vm1_OsDisk']" -o table
# Premium_LRS
caption: A 4-vCPU VM, still running two weeks after a load test, on a premium SSD.

code:
az vm deallocate --resource-group briarcliff-rg --name loadtest-vm1
az vm resize --resource-group briarcliff-rg --name loadtest-vm1 \
  --size Standard_B2s
az disk update --resource-group briarcliff-rg \
  --name loadtest-vm1_OsDisk --sku StandardSSD_LRS
caption: Deallocate to stop compute billing now, then resize the VM and disk to match reality.
